                                                  SPARKLE Conference Dock, USB4 40Gbps, 9 Ports of Connectivity, Single 8K /
                                                  Dual 4K Output, AEC / NR / 4MICs with 5W Speaker, Dual Power Mode,
                                                  Windows/MacOS Compatible, TD-8140S

                                                  USB4 came with 40Gbps Upstream, as Thunderbolt, SPARKLE Conference Dock is ready to start an
                                                  online meeting with your team anytime, anywhere. Take advantage of the Dual Power Mode and
                                                  AEC/NR/4MICs with 5W Speaker, find yourselves a desk and place your laptop with Conference
                                                  Dock and the meeting is ready to start. Or you can use it as an office dock by plug in any external
                                                  power thru Type-C, SPARKLE Conference Dock can deliver maximum 85W to your host device with
                                                  9 ports connectivity.
